name: Integration Tests - Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  extract-and-run:
    name: Extract and Run Commands
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:

          - fixture: yarn-app
            package_manager: yarn
            test_script: lint

            package_manager: yarn
            test_script: tsc
          - fixture: yarn-app
            package_manager: yarn
            test_script: jest
          - fixture: yarn-app
            package_manager: yarn
            test_script: test:rntl
          - fixture: yarn-app
            package_manager: yarn
            test_script: test:hooks
          - fixture: npm-app
            package_manager: npm
            test_script: lint
          - fixture: npm-app
            package_manager: npm
            test_script: format:check
          - fixture: npm-app
            package_manager: npm
            test_script: tsc
          - fixture: npm-app
            package_manager: npm
            test_script: jest
          - fixture: npm-app
            package_manager: npm
            test_script: test:rntl
          - fixture: npm-app
            package_manager: npm
            test_script: test:hooks
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run integration test
        run: |
          cd integration-tests
          npx ts-node run-single.ts \
            --fixture ${{ matrix.fixture }} \
            --package-manager ${{ matrix.package_manager }} \
            --test-script ${{ matrix.test_script }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          GITHUB_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

  community-tests:
    name: Community Repo Tests
    needs: extract-and-run
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        repo:
          - expo-community/example
          - expo-community/template
          - user/repo1
          - user/repo2
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run community test
        run: |
          cd integration-tests
          npx ts-node community-runner.ts \
            --repo ${{ matrix.repo }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  summary:
    name: Generate Summary Report
    needs: [extract-and-run, community-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate summary report
        run: |
          cd integration-tests
          npx ts-node summary-reporter.ts
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          GITHUB_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
